# 3Shamrocks Studio

> Brand and product design studio of Dave Markovich, Product Design Director since 2007, based in Modi'in, Israel. Brand, interface and working app, built in weeks. A fractional Head of Design for startups that just raised.

- 20+ years in product design, 10+ years in HealthTech.
- HealthTech work includes VIBRANT (TIME 2023 Best Inventions), where the VIBRANT app doubled refill reorders (68% vs 34%, ACG 2024), and brand and product marketing at AposHealth.
- Contact: dave@3shamrocks.com

## Services
- [AI-Ready Brand Sprint](https://3shamrocks.com/sprint/): 7 working days. Brand audit, refined identity, colour/type token system, an AI rulebook that keeps Claude and Figma on brand, and 20 launch assets. English and Hebrew.
